title: Sodium
description: A high-performance rendering engine replacement for Minecraft, which greatly improves frame rates and reduces micro-stutter.
body:
**Latest News (June 16, 2026)** - Sodium 0.9.x is now available for Minecraft 26.2, **_with early support for Vulkan!_** The performance of the Vulkan backend is already in a good place (even faster than before on many devices), and we expect to be able to improve it even further with future updates.

---
